cohort: 8752 women with a BMI ≥35 kg/m(2) who had a singleton birth at 38-42 weeks of gestation
finding: In women with a BMI ≥35 kg/m(2) at 38-42 weeks of gestation, planned vaginal delivery and planned CS resulted in comparable neonatal outcomes, while a failed trial of labor was associated with an increased risk of adverse neonatal outcomes.
